I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/php-src`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Heap-buffer-overflow in ext/hash/hash_xxhash.c (PHP_XXH64Update / XXH_INLINE_XXH64_update / XXH_memcpy). When processing an unserialized/updated xxhash context, an unchecked length derived from input is passed to memcpy, causing reads past the 32-byte hash state buffer. This results in heap out-of-bounds reads that can crash the process or lead to memory disclosure.
